venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CC ATL — Tuesday 8/4.** MOD Mkz/JK, entered by Mya. Net $2,340 vs target $2,036 (+14.9%); food $459; comps $29.90; 75 guests at $31.21 avg. Bingo Tuesday — high energy with lots of new faces, full house until close. Smooth start with meal deals rolling in. New hire Jayden trained with MOD. Reminder to reference Red Bull Bingo cocktails when possible. Kitchen: smooth night, great ticket times. 86'd Old Forester. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: seeing the space full until close.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CC NSH — Tuesday 8/4.** MOD KK & MD, Chef JMS; entered by BC. Net $6,095 vs target $1,437 (+324%), driven by the Qualifacts event ($5,147 event sales); food $39; comps $10.20 (0.17%); 27 non-event guests at $35.10 avg. Event guests arrived just before 5pm; team handled the influx well and host was complimentary. First night of the new event food menu — well received. Late push ~10pm: couples, a birthday, a Fishmonger group, Mayor Freddie O'Connell (returning guest), and a group of 15 coworkers. John Michael performed exceptionally in kitchen and on the floor. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 8/4.** AM/PM MOD Carey, PM Chef Rachel. Net $6,130.78 vs target $8,518 (-28.0%); DC/AM $653.01, D&C PM $5,477.77; food $1,396.70; comps $161.90 (2.64%); 162 guests (Tock). Slow evening — captured revenue from a large hotel group given a section to sit, work, eat and drink (great job Paige & Kayla). Kitchen: chill night; Rand came in to help close. Event note: Avalon Bay Inc. meeting 8am–5pm in suite 6A tomorrow — coffee/hot water/creamers ready at 8am. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 8/4.** MOD Seth + Steves; entered by Marielle. Net $3,295 vs target $3,800 (-13.3%); beverage $3,023, food $206, retail $26; comps $125 (DNLs and members); 124 covers at $30 avg. Classic Tuesday — slow start then everything at once, busy 8:30–11:30. Lots of twos and a couple of 6-tops; an 8-top tried to become a 16-top but couldn't be accommodated. Gorgeous weather may have kept the night slower; brief 9pm door rush, full bar at close. City towing for a film production called 'Gin Joint' — serendipitous. Welcomed Max, a birthday 6-top, and young industry guests incl. Hiro from Tins. Top sellers: Paper Wasp, Rosalie, Native Lion. Two no-shows (charged). Breakage: tulip, DOF, water vous.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 8/4.** MOD Joe, Chef Vic. Net $4,694 vs target $4,340 (+8.2%); food $841; comps $168.50 (Edwin, Matthew Malaa, Raymundo, Yiban, birthday, engagement, investor, DNL); 125 guests, $82.36 check avg. Steady Tuesday — slow first couple of hours, took off around 8pm with the reservation bulk, then steady walk-ins from 9pm; filled the 20s to accommodate everyone. Busy through last call with a smooth ending. Handful of returning guests not seen in a while. Kitchen steady. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: a guest stopping the MOD to say how good everything was.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: On the warmer side, cooled off as the night progressed
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 8/4.** MOD Marcus. Net $4,227.02 vs target $3,681 (+14.8%); Marquee bar $4,649.72; food $754.60; comps $4.30 (industry love); 94 guests (64 walk-in / 30 resos), GCA $46.97. Solid Tuesday with a steady stream of two-tops from the start; room and bar full by ~8pm. Rasaan staged in the kitchen alongside James and crushed it; Chaz had his first training day and impressed. Grant ran the floor solo with bar support; Devan balanced hosting and floor while training Chaz on SevenRooms. Ben and Alex delivered smooth bar service without a barback. Improve: don't rely on kitchen to run food. Maintenance: curtains (mend on the way). No incidents.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 8/4.** AM Sam & Shannon, PM Justin & Drew; entered by Justin. (Report typed as 8/3 Monday but posted Tue night 8/4 and references 'another chill Tuesday' — matched by post time.) Net $3,975 vs target $4,000 (-0.6%); Municipal Bar AM $874 / PM $2,882; Sun Club $219; Hot Eye $0; food $1,876; comps $37; 129 guests (59 AM / 70 PM) at $30.81 avg. Morning got moving by noon with a few tables plus food tours — Ezra solo serving with manager support. Evening: action in the 6:00 hour, long lull, pop at 9:00 before kitchen close; host for first push, 2 servers + SA, no barback needed. Sun Club dead until ~2pm, then a family and a few couples. Kitchen: slow, smooth, nothing sent back. Maintenance: left elevator down. No incidents.
